task: Four incident retrospectives sit in the incident_retrospective folder — a P0 payment outage in March, two P1s on data sync and push service, and a P2 on search. Read them together rather than one at a time and identify the causes appearing in more than one. For each recurring cause list the incidents it contributed to and whether the same action item was raised repeatedly without ever being completed. Comparing what was actually done against `incident_handlingsopguidelines_document.docx`, list the steps that were skipped.
